admissions.title: University entrance requirements for international students | University of Otago

quotes.text: China entrance requirements Successful completion of the National College Entrance Examination-Gaokao/NCEE with:An overall score* of 65% in the Sciences Stream or 65% in the Arts Stream as shown on the provincially issued results slip.
*The Gaokao score is an aggregate percentage calculated by dividing an applicant's total scores achieved by the maximum Gaokao score.

Senior High School graduation and one year of successful study at a recognised institution of university standing; or Senior High School graduation and completion of a diploma with high passing grades at a recognised institute or university.
You need a recognised university entrance qualification and English language skills.
Find out what the entrance requirements for your country are, what English language tests are accepted, and what documents you need to provide for a successful application.
